question: Who launched the official jersey of the fourth Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Thakur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anurag Thakur, the Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports, launched the official jersey for the fourth edition of the Khelo India Youth Games.
 
• The event took place in New Delhi on January 25, 2022.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games 2022 were held in Panchkula, Haryana, from June 4 to June 13, 2022.
 
• The games saw participation from over 8,500 athletes from across the country.
 
• The Khelo India program aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grass-root level by building a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Program**:

 
 
• Launched in 2018 by the Government of India to promote sports at the grass-root level.
 
• Aims to identify talent and provide them with an opportunity to hone their skills and compete at a higher level.
 
• Includes various components such as scholarships, infrastructure development, and support for athletes.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games**:
 
 
• An annual event under the Khelo India initiative.
 
• Features multiple sports disciplines where young athletes compete to showcase their talents.
 
• The event is rotated among different states each year to ensure nationwide participation.
 
 
 
• **Anurag Thakur**:
 
 
• Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports and Minister of Information & Broadcasting.
 
• He has been actively involved in promoting sports and youth activities in India.
 
 
 
• **Sports Development in India**:
 
 
• The government has launched several initiatives to boost sports infrastructure and talent identification.
 
• Programs like TOPS (Target Olympic Podium Scheme) support elite athletes in their preparation for international competitions.
